name: unreal-mcp-debug-host
description: VS Code-hosted cppvsdbg bridge for Unreal MCP debugging.

unrealMcpDebug.enginePath.description: Unreal Engine installation root, for example C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.7.

unrealMcpDebug.requireMatchingSymbols.description: Reject standalone launch when the project DebugGame Editor DLL/PDB pair is missing or stale.

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run compile && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --out artifacts/unreal-mcp-debug-host-0.1.0.vsix
